Step: f(x) $$=$$ |x|

Hint 1: Consider the shape of the scatterplot. Does the pattern of the data points suggest a relationship that could be captured by the absolute value function, which is symmetric around the y-axis?

Hint 2: Think about how the absolute value function, f(x) $$=$$ |x|, affects the values of $$x$$. It transforms negative $$x$$ values into positive ones, creating a V-shaped pattern. Does this transformation align with the pattern observed in the scatterplot?
